hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && { ./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern "$f" && ./node_modules/.bin/oxlint --type-aware --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern "$f"; } >&2 || exit 2
